title: Girlfriends Agnew Findlay and Blanche Franklin, the officers' ball and band trips
summary: He stays with Steve, then drifts from Agnew Findlay to Blanche Franklin; the band wins warrant-officer status for the officers' ball and travels to games where Hawkins' band plays.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Captain Dryer said it won't be long, a week. So sure enough, the week did pass and we went on back and everything and got back in school and all that is over and I don't know, got to be around with this other girl, Blanche, I believe it was Blanche Franklin, and Agnew kind of got wind of that and she got to thinking about how--
Agnew was my girlfriend who was taking all those notes.
Findlay, a girl out of Mobile, Alabama.
Anyway, so I just said altogether, I don't know, what it was is one big affair

that you look forward to in the band, you see, I mean like this ROTC like I was telling you about, they had captains and lieutenants but if you were in the band you couldn't be any captain or lieutenant but they would put you in the category of a warrant officer and then you could go to the officer's ball when it was held there.

So it was coming time for the officer's ball and I was going to take Blanche to the ball, and then, to show you how different things are now, we had--they would have the dance in the gym but you would go to White Hall, that is the largest building, being the girl's dormitory, and you could go in the waiting room and wait until your girl came downstairs and so, we were in there and so I was kind of winking at Agnew after that and the boys knew that she played piano, and so one of the guys,while we were waiting for everybody to come down, Agnew, why don't you play a number on the piano for us, while we're waiting around, and she played,
That's a very unique name for a woman. Agnew?
And so we went on to the dance and of course after the thing we were nothing but school sweethearts, but I went on with Blanche from then on in. She was out of Houston, Texas.

As we went on, as I said, we would go to--one of the reasons why I wanted to be in there, I liked the music and then you see, the band would get to travel to the football games and everything, and so when we went to Mobile--not to Mobile, Montgomery, when they played Alabama State, we went there and then it was over, Erskine Hawkins band would play, and of course Erskine was kind of Freeman guys, and then Steve used to say, well, I got him
